question: Chris Ford hit the NBA's first 3-pointer 47 years ago this week. That 1979-80 season, the Atlanta Hawks won their division. How many threes did they make ALL season?
answer_detail: Atlanta made 13 threes in 82 games and still went 50-32 to win the Central Division. The average team that year made 64. Today, teams often hit 13 in a single night.
